children: Bill Ackman is the latest outspoken investor to question the Nvidia board's handling of former CEO Jensen Huang's affair scandal.
The billionaire investor said he believes Nvidia's board rushed to take action, which led to Huang's exit, instead of carefully considering what was in the best interest of its shareholders.
"This looks like a series of major governance failures by directors that panicked due to headlines in the media," he wrote. "They couldn't stand the heat."
This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).
